summary: Build and execute the post-native snapshot crash wrapper with the operation-derived native name and an action/position-scoped gate. API impact: none.

guide.reason: This is a contributor-only fault-injection helper; it adds no operator workflow.

api.reason: The helper invokes a test wrapper around virsh and changes no Core, Controller or client API contract.

roadmap.reason: The regression closes a harness targeting defect only. The unique-operation native crash campaign remains pending and no milestone changes status.

state.reason: The helper creates temporary test files only; it adds no product state.

verification.method: `python3 -m unittest tests.test_core_local_snapshot_api -q` passed 18 tests; `python3 -m py_compile tests/integration/core_local_snapshot_api.py tests/test_core_local_snapshot_api.py` passed. Independent review confirmed positional matching, metadata/name non-matches, successful gate release and duplicate refusal. The native post-effect crash campaign has not yet rerun with a unique operation.
